purpose: Freeze per-Hero level-up gold and material costs for the five regular Hero Fetter tracks and the Hero HeartFetter track without reopening already-validated bond effect semantics.

relation.regular: canonical heroId -> frozen Hero shard -> bonds[]; preserve explicit order/fetterId/cost fields only
relation.heart: canonical heroId -> frozen HeartFetter raw evidence heroHeartFetterId + heroHeartFetterSourceIndex -> ConfigDataHeroHeartFetterInfo[sourceIndex], requiring exact ID equality
relation.item: cost ItemType=6 + ItemId -> ConfigDataItemInfo.ID only when all matching source records agree on Name/Desc/Icon

costPolicy.materials: explicit LevelUpMaterials rows grouped by Level; preserve ItemType, ItemId, Count
costPolicy.skillLocator: regular gotSkillIds[targetLevel-1] or HeartFetter HeroHeartFetterSkills[targetLevel-1]; locator only, no effect reinterpretation

completion: All 267 canonical Heroes have five frozen regular Fetter cost tracks plus one HeartFetter cost track, every level 2-10 cost is source-exact, every referenced material resolves without conflicting Item metadata, totals reproduce exactly, and validation leaves no unexpected tracked mutation.
